title: (Obj) for the constructible cocone
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime and $X$ a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian. The
constructible cocone ([def-sfb-constructible-cocone]) satisfies (Obj) of
[sk-def-sfb-filtered-two-colimit]: every $K\in D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Qlb)$ is isomorphic to
$T_{E,\Qlb}K_E$ for some finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Qlb$ and some
$K_E\in D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E)$.

proof.text: Use the specific finite-field Serre theorem through the finite-model proof API to equip each finite bounded-constructible category with inherited triangles. The closure extensions are exact, so their derived functors are triangulated after transporting the termwise shift structure. Compose their constructible restrictions with the full ambient inclusion to form an ambient cocone.

Fullness turns constructible HomSurj into ambient HomSurj. By the directed-triangulated-image theorem the union P of the ambient essential images is triangulated. Composing its witness isomorphisms shows that P is isomorphism closed.

For every constructible closure-coefficient sheaf M, finite-presentation descent supplies a constructible finite-coefficient sheaf model. Its single complex is bounded constructible by the finite-model proof API. Exact-derived compatibility with single complexes identifies its scalar extension with M[0], so P contains every such single complex.

Apply the proved finite bounded-cohomology devissage to P and the iso-closure of constructible sheaves. It gives an ambient finite model for K. The fully faithful constructible inclusion lifts its ambient isomorphism, proving EssSurjObj for the specified cocone.
